messages:
Sara: quick heads-up — seeing output drift when serving gemma-6b int8 with shared-bpe + injected sentinels. repro attached to bench run 172999.
Minh: can you paste the minimal serve config? streaming + kv layout?
Sara: yes, headwise kv + streaming. minimal:
```
model: gemma-6b-q8\ntokenizer: shared-bpe-v2\ninject_sentinels: true\nkvcache_layout: headwise\nrotary_base: 10000\nquant: int8\nstreaming: true
```
Devin: hmm extra tokens can shift token ids at the tail. did you verify token id mapping vs original HF vocab?
Sara: diffed a few anchors — tail ids shifted by +2 after conversion. not preserving original indices.
Minh: that explains it — if tokenid->embed mapping changes, previously cached KV entries refer to wrong embeddings when looked up headwise.
ci-bot: perf/regen bench failed: +11% perplexity on long-context (8k) suite — ci.redwood/172999/logs
Eva: is the rotary math also sensitive to the index shift (rotary params assume original positional semantics)?
Sara: float32 path matches reference. regression only shows up with int8 kernels enabled. quantization amplifies the aliasing.
Devin: quick isolation: 1) run with tokenmap that preserves HF indices (no sentinel remap), 2) same config but float32, 3) run short double-prefix KV replay. which step reproduces?
Sara: did those: keeping original ids -> drift gone. quant-only (no remap) yields negligible change. root cause looks like tokenid remap + headwise kvcache + int8 kernels.
Minh: action items: update tokenmap converter to avoid rebasing ids or emit a serve-time shim that reindexes incoming ids to model ids; add long-context smoke for any tokenizer remap CI; add small FP-tolerance check for int8 rotary ops.
Devin: i'll add a unit test that streams the same prefix twice and asserts identical k/v keys (mod evictions).
Sara: opened issue and attached failing prompt + mini repro. thanks.
ci-bot: issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/issues/4521
Eva: assigning to Minh + Sara, label eng-ml. reassign to eng-platform if runtime kernel changes needed.
Minh: will start a patch for tokenmap converter and a rebase shim.
Sara: will run the CI smoke locally and paste results. :eyes:
